c1-10-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Checking a Contract
c1-10-01.scenario: A friend asks you to read a short contract between two firms.
c1-10-01.prompt: Say that the parties agree on the price and that the annexes are part of the contract.
cues: Say what the parties agree on
c1-10-01.target: A felek kölcsönösen megállapodnak a vételár összegében. A mellékletek a szerződés elválaszthatatlan részét képezik.
c1-10-01.english: The parties mutually agree on the purchase price. The annexes form an inseparable part of the contract.
c1-10-01.canDo: I can write the key clauses of a contract (*megállapodnak*, *kötelezettséget vállal*).

c1-10-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Polite Counter-offer
c1-10-02.scenario: A friend's firm has received a supplier's offer with a price it cannot accept.
c1-10-02.prompt: Say that the offer is not acceptable now, but you would make a concession if the payment terms were better.
cues: Say the offer is not a basis now
Make the concession depend on a condition
c1-10-02.target: Jelenlegi formájában az ajánlat nem képezheti tárgyalási alapunkat. Hajlandóak volnánk engedményt tenni, amennyiben a fizetési feltételek kedvezőbbek.
c1-10-02.english: In its present form the offer cannot be a basis for negotiation. We would be willing to make a concession if the payment terms were better.
c1-10-02.canDo: I can answer an offer politely and keep the negotiation open (*jelenlegi formájában …, mindazonáltal …*).

c1-10-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Is Liable for the Delay
c1-10-03.scenario: A storm has delayed a building job and a friend asks whether the builder is liable.
c1-10-03.prompt: Say that the builder is released from liability if the storm was an unavoidable external cause.
cues: Say who is released from liability
c1-10-03.target: A vállalkozó mentesül a felelősség alól, ha a vihar elháríthatatlan külső ok volt.
c1-10-03.english: The builder is released from liability if the storm was an unavoidable external cause.
c1-10-03.canDo: I can name the clauses that limit or exclude liability (*felelősségkizárás*, *kötbér*, *vis maior*).

c1-10-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Decides in a Company
c1-10-04.scenario: A friend asks who decides about changing the articles of association of a company.
c1-10-04.prompt: Say that this is for the general meeting, and that the officer must act in the company's interest.
cues: Say what the officer must do
c1-10-04.target: A társasági szerződés módosítása a közgyűlés hatáskörébe tartozik. A vezető tisztségviselő köteles a társaság érdekében eljárni.
c1-10-04.english: Changing the articles of association falls within the competence of the general meeting. The executive officer must act in the company's interest.
c1-10-04.canDo: I can name the organs of a company (*közgyűlés*, *igazgatóság*, *felügyelőbizottság*).

c1-10-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Text Says About the Given Word
c1-10-05.scenario: You have read a short text about Márai Sándor, and a friend asks what it says about the given word.
c1-10-05.prompt: Tell your friend what the text says about the given word.
cues: Say what the text says the given word is
c1-10-05.target: A szöveg szerint az adott szó szentsége a polgári világ alapköve.
c1-10-05.english: According to the text, the sanctity of the given word is the cornerstone of the bourgeois world.
c1-10-05.canDo: I can report what a text says about a writer's idea (*A szöveg szerint …*).

c1-10-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Before Signing
c1-10-consolidation.scenario: A friend asks what you learned in this unit about negotiating a contract.
c1-10-consolidation.prompt: Say that the parties agree on the price, but you cannot accept the offer in its present form.
cues: Say what the parties agree on
Say what is not acceptable now
c1-10-consolidation.target: A felek megállapodnak az árban. Jelenlegi formájában az ajánlatot nem fogadjuk el, de nyitottak vagyunk az egyeztetésre.
c1-10-consolidation.english: The parties agree on the price. We do not accept the offer in its present form, but we are open to discussion.
c1-10-consolidation.canDo: I can write the key clauses of a contract.
